method: separate ten-response distribution per lens, then canonical consolidation
limitation: LLM role-play is not expert testimony. Probabilities are not empirical frequencies. Elo is supplied by independent critic tournament.

canonical_candidates.title: Survey-needed pitch checklist
canonical_candidates.first_step: List missing roof/budget/site checks in the pitch using existing warnings; no new readiness threshold, UI or safety certification.

canonical_candidates.title: One-question rescue on the existing planner
canonical_candidates.first_step: Rehearse a synthetic home with entered demand and show the existing Ask next re-design; cite the published oracle qualification separately.

canonical_candidates.title: Provenance audit for genuine 4500 versus defaults
canonical_candidates.first_step: Build paired synthetic requests with identical values and different provenance; inspect question and warning behavior.

canonical_candidates.title: Expert-style versus economic battery disagreement ledger
canonical_candidates.first_step: Capture frozen synthetic-home expert-style and simulator sweeps; report assumptions and disagreements, never claim optimal real savings.

canonical_candidates.title: Signed-option and target reconstruction ambiguity audit
canonical_candidates.first_step: Ask ETL owner for aggregate alternative-option sensitivity and target missingness, keeping option-selection rules fixed.

canonical_candidates.title: Tolerance-aware collision ceiling
canonical_candidates.first_step: Group exact observed inputs, find largest overlapping label-tolerance region, and distinguish empirical upper bounds from a population ceiling.

canonical_candidates.title: Rank historical bundles jointly
canonical_candidates.first_step: Use predeclared bundle K=10 or 20 from training only under research/experiments.md, rather than independent component regression.

canonical_candidates.title: Catalogue tolerance-mass classifier
canonical_candidates.first_step: Score candidate catalogue sizes by predicted tolerance-hit mass; compare on fixed pre-2026 folds.

canonical_candidates.title: Paired per-home model versus median win/loss audit
canonical_candidates.first_step: Publish aggregate paired wins/losses by component and missingness; no held-out rows.

canonical_candidates.title: Conservative savings sensitivity envelope
canonical_candidates.first_step: Freeze tariff, generation, load-profile and cost scenarios before evaluating fixed synthetic designs.

canonical_candidates.title: Cohort-qualified MaStR percentile
canonical_candidates.first_step: Use verified gross-PV units and rooftop/year/status filters; label residential-like proxy and avoid unsupported storage linkage.

canonical_candidates.title: Measured-profile simulation gap
canonical_candidates.first_step: Compare fixed systems on normalized measured loads with the current smoothed load; retain annual energy normalization and profile year.

canonical_candidates.title: Locks and existing-assets invariants stress ledger
canonical_candidates.first_step: Freeze valid/invalid/review expectations, run synthetic cases, and report eligible/pass/fail/blocked denominators.

canonical_candidates.title: Selective risk versus coverage curve
canonical_candidates.first_step: Fit abstention thresholds on pre-2026 validation; show the cost of deferring difficult homes without hiding them.

canonical_candidates.title: Question value per minute of customer effort
canonical_candidates.first_step: Keep existing price-swing score as a heuristic; annotate survey versus bill versus yes/no effort, not unmeasured accuracy value.

canonical_candidates.title: Buying propensity versus physical requirement
canonical_candidates.first_step: Explain that wallbox labels measure offer inclusion; EV fields and a purchaser future intent can differ.

canonical_candidates.title: Offline replay and artifact receipt
canonical_candidates.first_step: Record hashes of policy, catalogue, config and generated case code plus OFFLINE status; rerun deterministic outputs.

canonical_candidates.title: Unseen-installer calibration audit
canonical_candidates.first_step: Use existing leave-one-installer-out results and compare interval coverage/width; two installers do not prove generalization.

canonical_candidates.title: New versus total retrofit accounting audit
canonical_candidates.first_step: Ask owner to freeze existing-PV/storage semantics, then check proposal, BOM and simulation use the same boundary.

canonical_candidates.title: Heat-pump evidence scope card
canonical_candidates.first_step: State limited HP labels and physics-led sizing; do not claim learned heat-loss engineering.

canonical_candidates.title: One-more-module scenario difference
canonical_candidates.first_step: Run fixed-home roof caps with actual module watts; report changed proposal and scenario economics, not a universal shadow price or monotonicity law.

canonical_candidates.title: Pareto menu of approved alternatives
canonical_candidates.first_step: Inspect existing alternatives first; retain only dominated-free cost/autarky points under a common simulation and planner approval.

canonical_candidates.title: Remove unsupported labor and superiority claims
canonical_candidates.first_step: Replace elapsed lead time with elapsed lead time, and overall win with PV win plus whole-design tie; reconcile latency claim.

canonical_candidates.title: Frozen score-definition sensitivity
canonical_candidates.first_step: Keep original whole-design metric primary; compare module, presence and any-option metrics with identical predictions as diagnostics.

canonical_candidates.title: Differentiate against an auto-layout race
canonical_candidates.first_step: Position installer habits plus useful missing-information questions; do not claim competitors lack them.

canonical_candidates.title: Bundle regret alongside agreement
canonical_candidates.first_step: Specify an independently priced regret proxy before testing; never substitute simulator preference for expert ground truth.

canonical_candidates.title: Roof and budget field-collection experiment
canonical_candidates.first_step: Ask mentors to label 20 new opt-in cases prospectively with roof/budget; define future evaluation before collecting.

canonical_candidates.title: WILDCARD: show the median winning live
canonical_candidates.first_step: Use a frozen synthetic example or aggregate segment and explain why assistance still matters; no cherry-picked superiority.

canonical_candidates.title: WILDCARD: sell the information before the equipment
canonical_candidates.first_step: Prototype a text-only survey-needed handoff; price of information is a hypothesis, not a measured revenue claim.

canonical_candidates.title: WILDCARD: uncertainty expiry energy passport
canonical_candidates.first_step: Define a future versioned facts-and-assumptions export that expires when tariff, roof or household facts change.
